name: PM-KISAN (demo rule)
benefit: Eligible landholding farmer families may receive income support in instalments.
description: Income support for eligible farmer families. Land-record and exclusion conditions apply.
how: Check land records and apply through the official PM-KISAN portal or a Common Service Centre.

name: PM Vishwakarma (demo rule)
benefit: Skill training, toolkit incentive and access to concessional credit for eligible traditional artisans.
description: Support for eligible workers in specified traditional trades. Actual trade list and other conditions apply.
how: Register through an official CSC and complete verification.

name: PM SVANidhi (demo rule)
benefit: Working-capital loan support for eligible street vendors.
description: Credit support for eligible street vendors; certificate of vending or local-body verification may be required.
how: Check eligibility with your Urban Local Body or an official lending institution.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (demo rule)
benefit: Pension savings scheme with government-defined contribution and pension options.
description: For eligible subscribers aged 18–40. Tax-payer restrictions and current enrollment rules apply.
how: Enquire at a participating bank or post office.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana (demo rule)
benefit: LPG connection support for eligible adult women from poor households.
description: Eligibility depends on household deprivation/category and no existing LPG connection; income filter is illustrative only.
how: Apply through an LPG distributor or official portal after checking current criteria.

benefit: Scholarships offered through participating central and state schemes.
